steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove a piece stuck. You built **Find product collisions** in *API products, and gateways compared*. Now write it again from an
**empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution to peek at. The tests are exactly the ones you passed
Why: pulling something out of memory is what makes it stay there. Reading your old code feels like knowing
it; rebuilding it cold shows whether you do. If you get stuck, that is useful news: go back to the lesson,
then come back and try again tomorrow.
This check, plus the boss, is what proves the module.

steps.title: Rebuild Find product collisions cold
prompt: The tests declare `record ProductOp(string Api, string Method, string Path);` (paths are relative to the product context).

Write `List<string> Collisions(List<ProductOp> ops)`. Two operations **collide** when they have the same method (ignore case) and the same number of segments, and at every position the segments are equal (ignore case) **or at least one of them is a `{parameter}`** (a parameter matches any literal, so `/{isbn}` and `/search` collide too).
Return one line per colliding pair, in input order (`i < j`): `"{METHOD} {path1} ({api1}) vs {path2} ({api2})"` with the method upper-cased.
**From memory this time:** the editor starts empty and the tests are the ones you passed in the lesson.
